answer: Every agent in the economy earns weight the slow way, like a vine that thickens only by adding real rings: identity is attested over months of settled trades, not bought at the door. Newcomers cross the border like a voyage, paying escrow that established members co-sign; if a clone farm is found, every co-signer forfeits stake. Sybil attackers face a karst economy - solid on the surface, but every shortcut drains straight into a sinkhole - so patience, not volume, becomes the only cheap path.
